name: Electrocute
text: Within 3 seconds, hit the same enemy champion with 3 basic attacks or abilities to cause additional adaptive damage to the target. Damage value: 40-210 (based on level) + 10% extra [ad] + 5% [ap] Cooldown: 20-13s (based on level)

name: Dark Harvest
text: Damaging a champion below 50% health deals adaptive damage and harvests their soul, permanently increasing Dark Harvest's damage by 11. Dark Harvest damage: 35+ 11 per soul + 10% bonus [ad] + 5% [ap] Cooldown: 20s (Resets to 1s on takedown)

name: Empowerment
text: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive attacks deals bonus adaptive damage and amplifies your damage dealt by 8% until you leave combat with champions. Adaptive Damage: 40-165 (based on level) Cooldown: 4s. Damage amplification will only take effect against champions.

name: Lethal Tempo
text: Gain stacks of Attack Speed when attacking enemy champions. Stacks up to 6 times. At max stacks, you gain bonus range and can exceed the Attack Speed cap. Each stack: increase 6-14% (Melee) or 3.5-8% (Ranged) Attack Speed for 6 seconds. At max stack bonus: Gain 25 (Melee) or 50 (Ranged) Attack Distance.

name: Fleet Footwork
text: Moving, attacking and casting builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack gains Attack Speed, heals you, grants bonus [moveSpeed] Movement Speed. If the attack is again st a champion, it also restores Mana or Energy. Bonus Attack Speed: 40% Health Restore: 15-110 (based on level) + 15% bonus [ad] + 10% [ap]. Bonus Movement Speed: 20% for 1s. When attacking a champion, restore 8% missing mana [mana] or 8% missing energy [energy]. When attacking minions or monsters, heals for 35% (Melee champions) or 15% (Ranged champions) of the original heal amount.

name: Conqueror
text: Gain stacks of Adaptive Force when hitting a champion with separate attacks or abilities. Stacks up to 6 times. When fully stacked, gain bonus omnivamp. Per stack: 3-5 bonus [ad] or 4-8 [ap] for 6s. Fully stacked bonus: Melee - 9%, Ranged - 5% bonus Omnivamp [omnivamp].

name: Grasp of the Undying
text: Every 3s in combat, your next attack on a champion will be enhanced. Bonus magic damage: 3.3% [hp] Heal: 1.3% [hp] Permanently health increase: 10 On Ranged champions, the effects are reduced by 60%.

name: Guardian
text: Guard allies within 350 units of you and allies you target with abilities for 2.5 seconds. While guarding, if you or the ally take more than a certain amount of damage, both of you gain a shield for 1.5 seconds. Shield: 40–165 (based on level) + 6% bonus [hp] + 15% [ap] Damage threshold: 70–240 damage taken (based on level) Cooldown: 55–25s (based on level)

name: Aery
text: Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies. Damage: 15-70 (based on level) + 10% bonus [ad] + 5% [ap] Shield: 25-120 (based on level) + 10% bonus [ad] + 5% [ap] Aery cannot be sent out again until she returns to you.

name: Arcane Comet
text: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location. When a comet hits an enemy champion, the next comet's damage increases. Damage: (15 to 100) + (2 x total hits on enemy champions) + 10% bonus [ad] + 5% [ap]. Cooldown: 16-8s (based on level)

name: Phase Rush
text: Using basic attacks or abilities on an enemy champion 3 times within 4s grants [moveSpeed] Movement Speed and reduces the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%. Duration: 3s. Movement Speed bonus: Melee - 40%-60% (based on level) | Ranged - 20-35% (based on level). Ability Haste: 10. Slow Resist: 60%. Cooldown: 21-7s (based on level)

name: First Strike
text: Initiating combat with an enemy champion or dealing damage to them within 0.25s of engaging them in combat grants 10 gold and First Strike for 3s, allowing you to deal 7% bonus true damage to them. After the effect ends, gain bonus gold based on the bonus damage dealt for its duration. If you do not deal damage to the enemy champion within 0.25s of engaging them in combat, First Strike will go into a 10-second cooldown. Bonus gold: Melee: 65% of bonus damage. Ranged: 45% of bonus damage. Cooldown: 20-30s

name: Ice Overlord
text: Immobilizing an enemy champion causes 3 beams to form around them, creating ice beneath them for 3 seconds and slowing enemies inside. The slow lingers on enemies for 1.5 seconds after they’ve left the ice zone. Gain a protective layer of ice around yourself, increasing your defenses. After a brief delay, the ice explodes, dealing a burst of magic damage around you. Slow: (1% of your bonus Health + 15%). Defenses: 35 + 75% bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Lasts 2.5 seconds. Magic damage: 15–100 (based on level) + 5% max [hp] Cooldown: 20s

name: Cheap Shot
text: Deals 10-45 bonus true damage to enemies whose movement is impaired. Cooldown: 7s

name: Sudden Impact
tagline: Triggers when in stealth or dashing
text: Damaging an enemy champion deals a bonus 15-65 true damage after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when exiting stealth for 4s. The damaging attack/ability gains bonuses at higher levels: Level 5: Deal an additional 5 true damage. Level 9: Deal an additional 5 true damage and gain 10% Movement Speed for 1.5s after dealing the damage. Cooldown: 10s

name: Empowered Attack
text: Every 8 seconds, the next attack will be empowered, dealing 20-60 bonus adaptive damage (based on level) to anemy champions. Ranged champions deal 80% damage.

name: Chain Assault
tagline: Triggers on attack after hitting a target with an ability
text: Hitting an enemy champion with an active ability applies a mark to them, causing your next 2 attacks or active ability casts against them to deal bonus adaptive damage equal to (12-38 (based on level) + 3% bonus [ad] + 1.5% [ap]). Cooldown: 15s

name: Tyrant
tagline: Deal damage to low Health enemies
text: When damaging a champion below 50% Health, deal (20-70 (based on level) + 6% bonus [ad] + 3% [ap]) bonus adaptive damage. Cooldown: 10s

name: Hubris
tagline: Kills temporarily increase Attack Damage/Ability Power
text: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them grants (5 + 1 per champion kill you've scored) Adaptive Force for 30 seconds.

name: Eyeball Collector
text: Gains 1.5 [ad] or 3 [ap] after scoring a champion or epic monster takedown, stacking up to 8 times.

name: Ingenious Hunter
text: Gains 20 Item Ability Haste. For each champion or epic monster takedown you score, gain an additional 5 Item Ability Haste. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Relentless Hunter
text: Gain 10 out-of-combat Movement Speed. For each champion or epic monster takedown you score, gain 2 out-of-combat Movement Speed. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Zombie Ward
tagline: Vision control increases Attack Damage/Ability Power
text: Takedowns on enemy wards spawn a Zombie Ward in its place, granting vision of the surrounding area for 120 seconds. Additionally gain 3 [ad] or 6 [ap] (max 5 stacks). (Assists on enemy wards also grant stacks and spawn Zombie Wards.)

name: Brutal
text: Attacks deal (5 + 6% bonus [ad] + 3% [ap]) bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions.

name: Triumph
tagline: Increase damage when low in Health
text: Champion takedowns restore 10% of lost health and 10% of maximum Mana [mana] Energy [energy] and grant 35 Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

name: Battle Zeal
text: Gain 1.4% stacking basic ability damage amplification every 1 seconds while in combat with a champion. Stacks up to 3 times and only takes effect against enemy champions.

name: Last Stand
tagline: Increase damage when low in Health
text: When health is lower than 60% [hp], attacks launched at enemy champions deal 5-11% bonus adaptive damage. Grants maximum bonus damage when Health is lower than 30% [hp]

name: Cut Down
tagline: Deal more damage to high Health enemies
text: Your attacks deal 6.57% bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions with more than 60% Health.

name: Coup de Grace
tagline: Increase damage to low Health enemies
text: Your attacks deal 8% bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions with less than 40% Health.

name: Legend: Alacrity
text: Gains 3% Attack Speed. Takedown monsters, enemy champions, or minions to gain up to an additional 18% Attack Speed.

name: Legend: Tenacity
text: Gains 3% Tenacity and 3% Slow Resist. Takedown monsters, enemy champions, or minions to gain up to an additional 15% Tenacity and 20% Slow Resist.

name: Legend: Bloodline
text: Gains 1% Omnivamp [omnivamp]. Takedown monsters, enemy champions, or minions to gain up to an additional 7% Omnivamp [omnivamp].

name: Demolish
text: When within 550 range of an enemy turret, gain a charge every 0.5s, up to 6 times. When fully charged, your next attack against the turret deals an additional (100 + 22% max Health [hp]) physical damage. Cooldown: 30s

name: Font of Life
text: When your attacks or abilities hit an enemy champion, heal yourself and the lowest Health allied champion nearby. Ally: Heals for 1.5% of your max [hp] + 5% of your [ap] You: Heal for 1% of your max [hp] + 5% of your [ap] Healing is 130% effective if you're a melee champion. (Does not trigger if you or nearby allies are at full Health, or if no allies are nearby.) Cooldown: 15s

name: Courage of the Colossus
text: Gains a shield that absorbs up to 25-45 (based on level) + 1% of max Health [hp] for 3s when immobilizing an enemy champion. Cooldown: 18s

name: Unshakeable
tagline: Increase Armor, Magic Resist, and Slow Resist
text: Gain 3% Armor and Magic Resistance. For every 1 enemy champions nearby, gain an additional 2% Armor and Magic Resistance. If the max number of enemy champions are nearby (max: 3), you also gain 20% Slow Resist.

name: Second Wind
text: Gain 5 Health [hp] every 5 seconds. After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate 3 + (1.5% of your missing health) [hp] over the next 5 seconds. This effect is doubled for melee champions.

name: Nullifying Orb
text: If you take damage from a champion that causes you to fall below 35% of your max Health, gain a shield that absorbs up to 60-180 (based on level) damage for 4s. Cooldown: 60s

name: Bone Plating
text: When taking damage from a champion, the current and next 3 champion abilities or attacks against you and within 1.5s deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage. Cooldown: 40s

name: Overgrowth
text: For every 3 enemy minions or 3 monsters killed nearby, permanently gain 3 max Health. Max Health can be increased indefinitely this way. Gain an additional 3% max Health upon reaching 30 stacks.

name: Revitalize
text: Gains a 5% amplification effect when Healing or granting Shields. If the target's Health is lower than 40%, the effect is amplified by an additional 10%.

name: Perseverance
text: Gain 10% Tenacity. Gain 10-15 Armor and Magic Resistance (based on level) for 1.5 seconds when mmobilized. Refresh duration time when immobilized multiple times.

name: Axiom Arcanist
text: Your ultimate ability has 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding. (AoE damage is reduced to a 5% increase.) Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your ultimate ability's remaining cooldown by 7%.

name: Manaflow Band
text: Hitting an enemy champion with and ability or empowered attack permanently increases your max mana [mana] by 30, up to 300 mana.

name: Botanist
text: When you destroy a plant, gain 30 gold and empowered plant effects. Soulflowers near the turrets also grant additional bonuses. Honeyfruit: Heal is increased by 20% when consumed. Scryer's Bloom: Vision granted lasts 20% longer when destroyed. Blast Cone: Gain 40% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds after the knockback.

name: Hextech Flashtraption
tagline: Gain short-range movement while Flash is on cooldown
text: While Flash is on cooldown, it is replaced by Hexflash. Dash a distance based on charge time (max 2s). Entering combat with enemy champions to trigger a 6-second cooldown. Cooldown: 18s

name: Transcendence
text: Gain a bonus when reaching the following levels: At level 1, gain 5 Ability Haste; at level 5, gain bonus 5 Ability Haste; at level 9, after Basic Ability hit the target, reduce 8% the ability's cooldown time. Cooldown: 8s

name: Celerity
text: Gain 2% Movement Speed. All Movement Speed bonuses on you are also increased by 7%.

name: Absolute Focus
tagline: Gain Attack Damage/Ability Power at high Health
text: While above 65% Health, gain a bonus 2–20 Attack Damage (based on level) or 2–30 Ability Power (based on level) (Adaptive).

name: Scorch
text: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability burns them, dealing 21-49 bonus magic damage (based on level) after 1 seconds. Cooldown: 8s

name: Nimbus Cloak
text: After using a Spell (Flash, Ignite, etc.), 10% - 40% movement bonus for 3 seconds. The speedup effectiveness depends on the Spell's cooldown.

name: Gathering Storm
tagline: Increase Attack Damage/Ability Power over time
text: Starting from 6 minutes into the game, gain increasing Attack Damage or Ability Power (Adaptive). Bonuses increase time, totaling 2/5/9/14/etc. [ad] or 4/10/18/28/etc. [ap] based on game time.

name: Ixtali Seedjar
text: After destroying a plant, immediately gain a seeds that replaces your trinket for 60 seconds. The seed matures and self-destructs after it is planted at a target location. (Seeds you can pick up will also drop when an ally destroys a plant.) Seeds become obtainable 2 minutes after the game starts. Cooldown: Each plant has a unique 30s
